cross_reference.description: 3 of the 4 lost R2R-profile leads (of 6 total R2R meetings) were lost specifically because rent-to-rent economics did not clear the bar — landlord rent level left insufficient margin after Stayful's management fee and setup costs; the remaining lost R2R lead (1) was disqualified on model mismatch (shared accommodation) rather than margin.
cross_reference.prevention: Pre-qualify R2R leads on rent level versus STL gross-revenue ceiling before booking the web meeting, so deals where the margin structurally cannot work are filtered out early.

cross_reference.description: 3 of 18 total PURCH-profile leads were lost while the property purchase itself was still in progress — each either chose an alternative (developer management, long-letting instead) or lost momentum before legal completion.
cross_reference.prevention: Run a structured, proactive check-in cadence with PURCH-profile leads through to legal completion rather than an open-ended follow-up, since the competing decision (or drop-off) tends to happen inside that window.
